My recipe for chuck roast uses a Dutch oven:
1 tbsp lard or tallow
1 kg chuck, cut into 2.5 cm cubes
1 tsp bicarbonate of soda
Salt and pepper to taste 

Heat the fat on medium heat. 
Add the meat, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
When the meat has let out some of the moisture add the bicarbonate.
At this point there will be a kind of scummy mix on the surface. Looks awful. I even tried removing it because I didn’t like the look of it. Don’t worry about it. It disappears when the moisture cooks out. 
When the meat is browned add enough water to just cover it.
Bring to the boil. 
Cover.
REMEMBER to take the heat down to lowest. 
Cook for 1 hour. 
At this point you can add any veggies you like if you eat them.
Cook for a further half hour. 

Delicious.
